# Charles Omollo Omondi

> Portfolio of Charles Omollo Omondi — Cybersecurity Engineer, AI Security Innovator, Software Engineer, and IT Support specialist based in Nairobi, Kenya.

Charles Omollo Omondi is a cybersecurity specialist and software engineer with hands-on experience across IT support, data management, sales & CRM, ethical hacking, and AI security research. The site showcases his education, professional experience, projects (including SalamaNet AI), certifications (Cisco Ethical Hacking, IVE Abroad Students), achievements, and a contact section.
